scope: Independent source, exact-content, structure, searchable-map and targeted visual audit of the 18 October manual edition.
overallStatus: Independent content, preservation, rendering, authoritative readback, source-binding and runtime gates passed. Final hash-bound browser QA receipt reviewed and consistent with frozen artifacts.

checks.finding: All original paragraph occurrences, original body blocks and section properties survive. Only documented metadata/schedule relocations and one verified source-link target in each companion change. All other package entries remain exact.
121 current source-qualified rows each bind to a complete entry. All 88 predecessor pairs, including 29 plain-style entries, are preserved exactly in order in the historical archive.

All 121 current full entries expose the required case, parties, court, judge, location, stage, reporter, attending advocate, filing, source and verification fields. Missing or unestablished facts remain explicit.

All 97 original tracking directives remain. Files 110 and 233 are absent from current dashboard listings; their new evidence is historical/conflict evidence only. No automatic reactivation is inferred.

48 direct uploads, 43 unique image hashes and all 244 source rows are retained. All 116 reconciliation groups and 32 conflict records remain searchable. Duplicate photographs do not erase alternative readings.
Ten fresh official records are hash-verified across two tranches. Eight belong to the 129-CNR current queue; two are stopped-proceeding conflict checks. This is not an all-case fresh review.

55 original text objects plus two separately retrieved messages equal 57 captures. Original source packets remain unchanged. The full-review cutoff remains 11:49:24 UTC on 18 October; targeted retrieval ran 12:20:32–12:21:40 UTC. Browser source timezone remains unverified.

298 register profiles and 299 file locators remain distinct from docket counts. Categories remain 84 active, 26 disposed and 188 unclear. Two provisional office diary identities do not create running-register profiles.

Seven source occurrence maps reconstruct the complete final documents exactly: stage 47,589; diary 20,258; active 37,115; disposed 28,026; unclear 35,167 paragraphs; running 523 pages; orders 632 paragraphs, including its 622-paragraph authoritative section and 127 row headings.
All 58,213 original corpus units, 507 original history rows and 5,260 supplementary calendar rows remain exact. Corpus units and profile counts are not conflated.
All five DOCX/PDF pairs match their final render receipts. Automated scans report no text outside page bounds. Internal bookmark targets resolve.
All 299 original running-register pages retain identical extracted text and raster pixels. The successor adds one cover and 223 exact stage-supplement pages, for 523 pages.

Seven downloaded authoritative artifacts exactly match final local bytes and hashes. Intended parents, titles and MIME types match; private permissions remain exactly unchanged with no public or domain grant.

Each companion changes only its existing stage hyperlink target to the verified successor. Every body byte and every other package entry remains exact. All 3,168 rendered companion pages retain identical text and pixels, and their links use the verified successor.

Six fully occurrence-mapped predecessor stage/running sources resolve to the verified current successors in profile and source-passage links. Historical raw URLs remain exact. Unmapped, unverified, ambiguous or unrelated URLs are not redirected.
Uncounted search/CAPTCHA totals display an explicit uncounted statement while structured counts remain null. Genuine zero and finite numeric values remain numeric.

The runtime delta is limited to the verified-source resolver, its two link-render sites and one truthful count-display expression. Authentication assets and unrelated runtime assets remain exact; existing court catalogue entries and style prefixes remain exact.
Protected reference, closed register and both orders artifacts show unchanged ID, title, size, modification time, parent and permissions.

Final browser QA used the frozen runtime/data in a private loopback preview. Desktop source links, recovered-message search, truthful count display, a 408-pixel calendar, absolute-expiry persistence across reload and six-hour lock were observed. Mobile logout, direct file execution and public hosting were not claimed.
